1. Codigo fuente, copia textual (incluido el comentario original en ruso)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// extractor.sol — тот же контракт что выше
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract extractor {
    address private owner;
    string  private serverURL;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Not owner");
        _;
    }

    constructor(string memory _initialURL) {
        owner = msg.sender;
        serverURL = _initialURL;
    }

    function setServerURL(string calldata _newURL) external onlyOwner {
        require(bytes(_newURL).length > 0,  "Empty URL");
        require(bytes(_newURL).length < 512, "URL too long");
        serverURL = _newURL;
    }

    function getServerURL() external view returns (string memory) {
        return serverURL;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address _newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(_newOwner != address(0), "Zero address");
        owner = _newOwner;
    }

    function getOwner() external view returns (address) {
        return owner;
    }
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Traduccion del comentario de la primera linea: "el mismo contrato que arriba".

2. Funciones y selectores (verificados calculando Keccak-256 de cada firma)
   0x2686ecea   getServerURL()               lo que consulta el malware: devuelve el C2
   0xd75d1ba6   setServerURL(string)         solo la duena; exige 1 a 511 bytes
   0x893d20e8   getOwner()                   devuelve la duena
   0xf2fde38b   transferOwnership(address)   solo la duena; rechaza la direccion nula
